newsitem.title: USA: Marks Brothers retains advertising firm.
newsitem.headline: Marks Brothers retains advertising firm.

text.p: Marks Bros. Jewelers Inc said Friday it retained Barkley & Evergreen, a full-service advertising and marketing firm.

Barkley & Evergreen will provide full-service marketing communications, including strategic planning, media planning, advertising, database marketing and direct mail, and customer service consulting, it said.

"Historically, we have not engaged in a formal marketing effort, but we believe that as the jewelry retail industry continues to consolidate, it is important to build our brand awareness," Hugh Patinkin, chairman, said in a statement.
Marks Bros. is a national specialty retailer of fine jewelry, operating 179 stores in 24 states.
